human_presence.label: photographic_human
prompt_translation: Keep the approved face identity and P9 body proportions unchanged; refine only photographic human presence.
Make the eyes optically believable: natural lid-to-eyeball contact, realistic lash roots, natural off-white sclera, non-gem-like iris texture, and catchlights consistent with the existing key light.

Keep young skin relatively even in color while adding region-dependent optical response: soft forehead sheen, slightly stronger nose response, fine inner-cheek texture, softer outer-cheek diffusion, thinner eye-area response, and independent lip material.
Integrate makeup into real skin instead of replacing skin texture; keep brows, eyeliner, lashes and lip finish refined but not vector-clean or glass-plastic.
Build hair at multiple scales: primary masses, secondary bundles and only a small amount of fine irregular hair, with non-uniform highlight flow.
Use a photographic focus hierarchy and soft highlight roll-off rather than global digital sharpness; the face is the strongest focus while the full costume remains clearly readable.
Keep eyes, skin, lips, hair, makeup and nearby materials at a coherent realism level; do not overprocess one subsystem relative to the others.
human_presence.principle: Photographic human presence comes from coherent eye/skin/hair/makeup/camera behavior, not maximum texture, forced asymmetry, aging cues or global sharpening.

coherence.rule: adjacent realism channels should stay within one internal tier

round_plan.prompt_strategy: optical-human patch: eyes + skin optics + makeup integration + hair frequency + camera/focus coherence while locking identity, P9 proportion, costume and lighting layout
